ayahs.ar: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an
ayahs.e2: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran
ayahs.tr: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabi wa Qur-aa-nim Mubeen

ayahs.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims
ayahs.e2: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Rubamaa yawaddul lazeena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen

ayahs.ar: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know
ayahs.e2: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know
ayahs.tr: Zarhum yaakuloo wa tatamatta'oo wa yulhihimul amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree
ayahs.e2: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term
ayahs.tr: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa wa lahaa kitaabum ma'loom

ayahs.ar: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
ayahs.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter
ayahs.e2: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
ayahs.tr: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad
ayahs.e2: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo yaaa aiyuhal lazee nuzzila 'alaihiz Zikru innaka lamajnoon

ayahs.ar: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful
ayahs.e2: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”
ayahs.tr: Law maa taateenaa bil malaaa'ikati in kunta minas saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذࣰ ا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayahs.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved
ayahs.e2: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed
ayahs.tr: Maa nunazzilul malaaa'i kata illaa bilhaqqi wa maa kaanooo izam munzareen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian
ayahs.e2: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it
ayahs.tr: Innaa Nahnu nazalnaz Zikra wa Innaa lahoo lahaa fizoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il awwaleen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.en: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him
ayahs.e2: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals
ayahs.e2: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked
ayahs.tr: kazaalika naslukuhoo fee quloobil mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before
ayahs.tr: Laa yu'minoona bihee wa qad khalat sunnatul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ
ayahs.en: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend
ayahs.e2: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend
ayahs.tr: Wa law fatahnaa 'alaihim baabam minas samaaa'i fazaloo feehi ya'rujoon

ayahs.ar: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمࣱ مَّسۡحُورُونَ
ayahs.en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic
ayahs.e2: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
ayahs.tr: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجࣰ ا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad ja'alnaa fissamaaa'i buroojanw wa zaiyannaahaa linnaazireen

ayahs.ar: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ رَّجِيمٍ
ayahs.en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
ayahs.e2: And We protected it from every accursed devil
ayahs.tr: Wa hafiznaahaa min kulli Shaitaanir rajeem

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame
ayahs.e2: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare
ayahs.tr: Illaa manis taraqas sam'a fa atba'ahoo shihaabum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ مَّوۡزُونࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing
ayahs.e2: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance
ayahs.tr: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shai'im mawzoon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers
ayahs.e2: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wa mal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure
ayahs.e2: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure
ayahs.tr: Wa im min shai'in illaa 'indanaa khazaaa 'inuhoo wa maa nunazziluhooo illaa biqadarim ma'loom

ayahs.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers
ayahs.e2: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves
ayahs.tr: Wa arsalnar riyaaha la waaqiha fa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa asqai naakumoohu wa maaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor
ayahs.e2: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor
ayahs.tr: Wa innnaa la nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa nahnul waarisoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come]
ayahs.e2: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺
ayahs.tr: Wa la qad 'alimnal mustaqdimeena minkum wa laqad 'alimnal mustaakhireen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing
ayahs.e2: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing
ayahs.tr: Wa inna Rabbaka Huwa yahshuruhum; innahoo Hakeem 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire
ayahs.e2: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire
ayahs.tr: Waljaaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris samoom

ayahs.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud
ayahs.tr: Wa iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa' ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration
ayahs.e2: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely
ayahs.e2: So the angels prostrated all together—
ayahs.tr: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.en: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated
ayahs.e2: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others
ayahs.tr: Illaaa ibleesa abaaa ai yakoona ma'as saajideen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate
ayahs.e2: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as saajideen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
ayahs.en: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud
ayahs.e2: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala lam akul li asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled
ayahs.e2: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed
ayahs.tr: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa innaka rajeem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
ayahs.tr: Wa inna 'alikal la'nata ilaa Yawmid Deen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.e2: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “You will be delayed
ayahs.tr: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
ayahs.en: Until the Day of the time well-known
ayahs.e2: until the appointed Day.”
ayahs.tr: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
ayahs.e2: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi bimaaa aghwaitanee la uzayyinaana lahum fil ardi wa la ughwiyan nahum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants
ayahs.e2: except Your chosen servants among them.”
ayahs.tr: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me
ayahs.tr: Qaala haaza Siraatun 'alaiya Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators
ayahs.e2: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you
ayahs.tr: Inna 'ibaadee laisa laka 'alaihim sultaanun illaa manittaba'aka minal ghaaween

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all
ayahs.e2: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together
ayahs.tr: Wa inna jahannama lamaw'iduhum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبࣲ لِّكُلِّ بَابࣲ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءࣱ مَّقۡسُومٌ
ayahs.en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated
ayahs.e2: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”
ayahs.tr: Lahaa sab'atu abwaab; likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.en: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”
ayahs.tr: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin aamineen

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other
ayahs.e2: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another
ayahs.tr: Wa naza'naa ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen

ayahs.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبࣱ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ
ayahs.en: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed
ayahs.e2: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave
ayahs.tr: Laa yamas suhum feehaa nasabunw wa maa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen

ayahs.ar: ۞نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.en: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful
ayahs.e2: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
ayahs.tr: Nabbi' 'ibaadeee annneee anal Ghafoorur Raheem

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment
ayahs.e2: and that My torment is indeed the most painful
ayahs.tr: Wa anna 'azaabee uwal 'azaabul aleem

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham
ayahs.e2: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests
ayahs.tr: Wa nabbi'hum 'an daifi Ibraaheem

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ ا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you
ayahs.e2: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”
ayahs.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy
ayahs.e2: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo la tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.en: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform
ayahs.e2: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”
ayahs.tr: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaaa am massaniyal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing
ayahs.e2: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bilhaqqi falaa takum minal qaaniteen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray
ayahs.e2: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala wa mai yaqnatu mir rahmati Rabbiheee illad daaaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers
ayahs.e2: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala famaa khatbukum aiyuhal mursaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.e2: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
ayahs.e2: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all
ayahs.tr: Illaaa Aala Loot; innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.en: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind
ayahs.e2: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”
ayahs.tr: Illam ra atahoo qaddarnaaa innahaa laminal ghaabireen

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot
ayahs.e2: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot
ayahs.tr: Falamma jaaa'a Aala Lootinil mursaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown
ayahs.e2: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”
ayahs.tr: Qaala innakum qawmum munkaroon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing
ayahs.e2: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon

ayahs.ar: وَأَتَيۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.en: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful
ayahs.e2: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful
ayahs.tr: Wa atainaaka bilhaqqi wa innaa lasaadiqoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعࣲ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدࣱ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ
ayahs.en: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded
ayahs.e2: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”
ayahs.tr: Fa asri bi ahlika biqit'im minal laili wattabi' adbaarahum wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadunw wamdoo haisu tu'maroon

ayahs.ar: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعࣱ مُّصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning
ayahs.e2: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qadainaaa ilaihi zaalikal amra anna daabira haaa'ulaaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing
ayahs.e2: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing
ayahs.tr: Wa jaaa'a ahlul madeenati yastabshiroon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ
ayahs.en: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me
ayahs.e2: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me
ayahs.tr: Qaala inna haaa'ulaaa'i daifee falaa tafdahoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ
ayahs.en: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me
ayahs.e2: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”
ayahs.tr: Wattaqul laaha wa laa tukhzoon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people
ayahs.e2: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo awalam nanhaka 'anil 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]
ayahs.e2: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala haaa'ulaaa'i banaateee in kuntum faa'ileen

ayahs.ar: لَعَمۡرُكَ إِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
ayahs.en: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly
ayahs.e2: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺
ayahs.tr: La'amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ
ayahs.en: So the shriek seized them at sunrise
ayahs.e2: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise
ayahs.tr: Fa akhazat humus saihatu mushriqeen

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay
ayahs.e2: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay
ayahs.tr: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtamaa 'alaihim hijaaratam min sjijjeel

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern
ayahs.e2: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate
ayahs.tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil lilmutawassimeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلࣲ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.en: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road
ayahs.e2: Their ruins still lie along a known route
ayahs.tr: Wa innahaa labi sabeelim muqeem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers
ayahs.e2: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe
ayahs.tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatal lilmu'mineen

ayahs.ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers
ayahs.e2: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers
ayahs.tr: Wa in kaana Ashaabul Aikati lazaalimeen

ayahs.ar: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway
ayahs.e2: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road
ayahs.tr: Fantaqamnaa minhum wa innahumaa labi imaamim mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡحِجۡرِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.en: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad kazzaba ashaabul Hijril mursaleen

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.en: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away
ayahs.e2: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them
ayahs.tr: Wa aatainaahum Aayaatinaa fakaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

ayahs.ar: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure
ayahs.e2: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure
ayahs.tr: Wa kaanoo yanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan aamineen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.en: But the shriek seized them at early morning
ayahs.e2: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning
ayahs.tr: Fa akhazat humus saihatu musbiheen

ayahs.ar: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn
ayahs.e2: and all they achieved was of no help to them
ayahs.tr: Famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةࣱۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ
ayahs.en: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness
ayahs.e2: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously
ayahs.tr: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaaa illaa bilhaqq; wa innas Saa'ata la aatiyatun fasfahis safhal jameel

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator
ayahs.e2: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing
ayahs.tr: Inna Rabbaka Huwal khallaaqul 'aleem

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ
ayahs.en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an
ayahs.e2: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad aatainaaka sab'am mnal masaanee wal Qur-aanal 'azeem

ayahs.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
ayahs.e2: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers
ayahs.tr: Laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa maa matta 'naa biheee azwaajam minhum wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu 'mineen

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.en: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner
ayahs.e2: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—
ayahs.tr: Wa qul inneee anan nazeerul mubeen

ayahs.ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
ayahs.e2: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺
ayahs.tr: Kamaaa anzalnaa 'alal muqtasimeen

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.en: Who have made the Qur'an into portions
ayahs.e2: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others
ayahs.tr: Allazeena ja'alul Quraana'ideen

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
ayahs.e2: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all
ayahs.tr: Fawa Rabbika lanas'a lannahum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: About what they used to do
ayahs.e2: about what they used to do
ayahs.tr: Ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
ayahs.en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists
ayahs.e2: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists
ayahs.tr: Fasda' bimaa tu'maru wa a'rid anil mushrikeen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَفَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
ayahs.e2: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers
ayahs.tr: Innaa kafainaakal mustahzi'een

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know
ayahs.e2: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know
ayahs.tr: Allazeena yaj'aloona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhar; fasawfa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say
ayahs.e2: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad na'lamu annak yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.en: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him]
ayahs.e2: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray
ayahs.tr: Fasbbih bihamdi Rabbika wa kum minas saajideen

ayahs.ar: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ
ayahs.en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death)
ayahs.e2: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way
ayahs.tr: Wa'bud Rabbaka hattaa yaatiyakal yaqeen
